question: Where was the first edition of the ‘Rising North East’ Investors Summit, 2025, held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **first edition** of the **‘Rising North East’ Investors Summit** was held in **New Delhi** in **2025**.
 
• The summit was organized by the **Ministry of Development of North Eastern Region (MDoNER)** in collaboration with industry partners to attract domestic and international investments to **North East India**.
 
• The primary objective of the event was to showcase the untapped economic potential of the **eight North Eastern states**, highlighting them as the **new engine of India's growth**.
 
• The summit provided a strategic platform for **investors**, **policymakers**, and **state governments** to interact and discuss projects in sectors such as **infrastructure**, **renewable energy**, and **tourism**.
